items.heading: Odia Fish Fry (Macha Bhaja)
details: Key ingredients: fish, turmeric, red chili powder, rice flour, mustard oil
Marinate fish pieces in turmeric, red chili powder and salt.
Coat lightly with rice flour for a crisp crust.
Shallow-fry in hot mustard oil until golden on both sides.
Drain and serve hot with a wedge of lime.
